number.$description: Choose unitless values by their intended interface role instead of consuming primitive scale steps directly.

opacity.$description: Use opacity roles to communicate interface states consistently.

disabled.$description: Use as the opacity for disabled elements that remain visible but unavailable for interaction.

layer.$description: Use these stacking levels for the small set of shared application layers.

background.$description: Use for decorative content placed behind other content within an isolated component or application stacking context.

overlay.$description: Use when a host application needs an explicit overlay layer above its content. Keep document-ordered portal families, including Base UI nested popups, on a consistent automatic layer instead of assigning this value to individual parts.
